enabled.description: Read embedded text subtitles when a native scene player opens. No subtitle files are created.

showByDefault.description: Select a preferred embedded track when no existing captions are showing. You can change it in the player CC menu.

preferredLanguage.description: A language code such as en, eng, fr, or fra. Leave blank to use the browser language, then the file default.

indexEnabled.description: Index new or updated scenes and refresh caption metadata during playback. An initial library scan starts when a Stash tab opens.

refreshAfterScan.description: When automatic index maintenance is on, index new or changed files after a successful Scan. Known unchanged media are skipped. Keep a Stash tab open until Scan finishes. Off by default.
